_comment: CURATED DATABASE — every entry was checked against the manufacturer's own current support/download page (or, for GPUs, TechPowerUp, a stable and widely trusted driver mirror). A device is listed ONLY when a real, verifiable, official driver or control-software page exists for it; generic USB hubs, host/root controllers, and Windows in-box devices are deliberately left out. DIRECT DOWNLOADS that never go stale come from two fields: 'resolver' names a live lookup run every scan (e.g. 'nvidia-geforce' queries NVIDIA for the current Game Ready driver), and 'directDownload' is a vendor-maintained 'always latest' installer URL the vendor keeps pointed at the newest build (Intel DSA, SteelSeries GG, Razer Synapse). Per-version file URLs are otherwise NOT hardcoded (they rot within weeks) — those entries point at the vendor's stable support/drivers page. 'manifestUrl' can host an updated copy of this whole file for automatic refresh. Ordering matters: for a vendor with both a class-specific (pnpClass) entry and a general one, the class-specific entry must come FIRST so it wins for that class.
